title: Consolidating RLVR Capabilities Across Domains: A Deep Dive into Fusion Paradigms
abstract: arXiv:2608.27409v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves specific capabilities of large language models, but covering multiple capabilities often involves training separate domain experts and subsequently consolidating them. We organize three fusion paradigms by the artefacts they reuse: Merge combines expert task vectors, Mix RL pools their datasets, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) uses both. Because they have largely been studied in isolation, how they compare and how to choose among them remain unclear. We compare all three using shared experts and data across model scales and a multi-domain benchmark suite. Although their average performance differs by at most 1.4 points, the gap reaches 8.6 points on a single benchmark, with domain-level variation tracking cross-domain relations visible in task-vector geometry. translated_title: 跨领域巩固RLVR能力：融合范式的深入研究
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）提升了大型语言模型的特定能力，但覆盖多种能力通常需要训练单独的领域专家，随后进行整合。我们根据所复用的工件将三种融合范式进行组织：合并（Merge）结合专家任务向量，混合强化学习（Mix RL）汇集其数据集，而多教师策略蒸馏（MOPD）则同时使用两者。由于这些方法大多在孤立环境中研究，它们之间的比较以及如何选择仍不明确。我们使用共享专家和数据，在不同模型规模及多领域基准套件上比较了这三种方法。尽管它们的平均性能差异最多为1.4个百分点，但在单个基准上差距可达8.6个百分点，领域级变化与任务向量几何中可见的跨领域关系相关。训练动态揭示了不同约束：混合强化学习依赖于领域混合比例，而MOPD则重新...（注：摘要被截断，此处按提供内容翻译）
tldr: 本文系统比较了三种RLVR能力融合范式（合并、混合强化学习和多教师蒸馏），发现平均性能相近但领域级差异显著，且选择受训练动态和跨领域关系影响。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares three RLVR capability fusion paradigms (Merge, Mix RL, and MOPD), finding similar average performance but significant domain-level variation, with selection influenced by training dynamics and cross-domain relations.
